pages.title: Block of Chronosteel
pages.text: Nine chronosteel ingots fused into one block, a metal whose atoms keep slightly different time from their surroundings. It is cool, heavy and very slightly delayed, as if it reaches the hand a moment late.
$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)Compacting chronosteel made it easier to store and gave a larger mass whose clock I could rely on. I use the blocks wherever a structure needs a steady time reference.
Made in a crafting grid.$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): Plasma Metallurgy.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Casimir Energy Cell, Chronosteel Ingot, Singularity Compactor.
